request.query: Existing P06 query and actor/session/selected-warehouse rules unchanged.

compatibility.default: No header preserves original v1 event/document/meta shapes; explicit-read-fields-v1 alone does not enable this extension.
compatibility.old_backend: New FE accepts a missing timeline_link_contract marker as legacy, keeps existing events and creates no component link.
compatibility.claimed: The exact marker and component_issue_links capability are required together. Claimed malformed values or cross-scope identities fail parsing.
compatibility.document: Existing document remains unchanged; a COMPONENT_ISSUE_DOCUMENT never becomes a receipt/issue stock document.
compatibility.explicit_fields: The independent explicit-read-fields-v1 middleware may omit nullable values with sibling status reasons. It does not negotiate or grant component links. The current P06 FE adapter uses the nullable owner representation only.

statuses.AVAILABLE: Authorized exact movement/document/line/SKU/warehouse/case ownership match, currently POSTED.
statuses.FORBIDDEN: Component event remains readable under inventory.trace but component owner rights are absent. Link is null; no CID, case ID, number or private metadata supplied.
statuses.NOT_ESTABLISHED: An authorized component event lacks a complete valid exact posted owner link. Missing, malformed-source and wrong-scope references are not distinguished.
statuses.NOT_APPLICABLE: Not a LEDGER COMPONENT_ISSUE event. Link is null.

identity_validation: Page movement ID, movement_type=COMPONENT_ISSUE, qty_delta<0, source_type=COMPONENT_ISSUE_DOCUMENT
Line parent equals CID and line.sku_id equals movement.sku_id/product_id and requested SKU
Movement and CID warehouse equal the confirmed active warehouse; requested ITEM equals movement.item_id when applicable
Exact CID warranty_case_id passes P09 persisted case warehouse ownership and tenancy filters

authorization.p06: Existing sku.view, inventory.trace and ITEM permissions remain required.
authorization.component_owner: (warranty.view OR warranty.manage) AND documents.read AND warranty.component_issue, using existing P09 owner scope.
authorization.tenancy: P09WarrantyScope applies trusted actor/warehouse dimensions to movement, CID, line, case and persisted case owner sources; unresolved tenancy is an error.
authorization.navigation: FE checks current actor/session/warehouse at click, then opens P20 with exact caseId and CID. P20 revalidates current ACL, warehouse, case, document and POSTED status.

query_policy: One page-batched link query inside the existing P06ReadSnapshot, after unchanged paging/count/sort. No N+1, external calls, writes, new routes or migrations.

errors.owner: Existing owner auth/session/warehouse/tenancy errors propagate; database errors do not become empty success.

forbidden_fallbacks: Creating or repeating a stock write
